verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Who are we
That You would be mindful of us?

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
What do You see
That's worth looking our way?

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
We are free
In ways that we never should be

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Sweet release
From the grip of these chains

verse.name: p1a
verse.lines:
Like hinges straining
From the weight

verse.name: p1b
verse.lines:
My heart no longer
Can keep from singing

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
All that is within me cries
For You alone be glorified

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
My heart sings a brand new song
The debt is paid, these chains are gone

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Lord, You know
Our hearts don't deserve Your glory

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
Still You show
A love we cannot afford

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
Like hinges straining
From the weight

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
My heart no longer
Can keep from singing

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Such a tiny offering
Compared to Calvary

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
And nevertheless
We lay it at Your feet
